verdict.rationale: Check documents an MCP server that lets users work in natural language from external AI clients such as Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT. That is delegation through third-party assistants, not a built-in AI assistant inside Check's own Console or Components. A payroll platform could plausibly ship an embedded assistant, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
